message:
docs(keepalive-multi r1): the resource table -- what each 0.2.30 global becomes (entry / binding / lifecycle epoch / UI)

Written before any move (contract 2): the native globals (controller, rendezvous, gate,
candidate/error strings, counters, the one decoder sink, the macro), the MainActivity
state that belongs to one PC connection or to one active binding, and how each of the
66 JNI calls is to be addressed (entry handle, binding token taken at the call, or
global). Also the fixture finding: the directory's hostId is (account, machineId) and
the test host's machineId is the PC's MachineGuid, so two test hosts on one PC need a
test-build-only machineId.
